title: Largest element of a vector, with recursion
statement: Define a recursive FindLargest function that takes an array of 5 integers by reference, a starting index and a size, and returns the largest element from that index to the end. Read 5 numbers and write the largest of them all, using that function.

assertions.requirement: The statement asks you to solve it with an array.

assertions.name: FindLargest
assertions.requirement: The statement asks for a recursive function named FindLargest with three parameters.
